title: Seabourn | Luxurious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Seabourn is a pet-friendly lakefront home in WaterSound West with bikes, a golf cart, private outdoor living, and quick access to the beach and pool.
description_expanded: Seabourn Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee/per pet is required prior to your arrival. - Lakefront home with screened-in patio featuring outdoor dining, lounge area, fireplace, outdoor gas grill, and outdoor TV with lake views - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles - Enjoy exploring the neighborhood and 30A on the 4 provided Taxi Bikes - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - 4 Tommy Bahama Beach Chairs, 2 beach umbrellas, and a beach cart available at the home - Located in the quiet, gated community of WaterSound West, only 0.5 miles to dining at Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Bean Coffee, and Buddy's Seafood Market - 1 minute bike ride to the community pool - Zero entry community pool with communal grills, dining tables with umbrellas, pool side loungers, and restrooms. Entrance to neighborhood beach boardwalk located at the pool. The community pool is heated seasonally (subject to change by the HOA). - Private WaterSound West beach LSV (golf cart) parking is 0.2 miles from the driveway. So easy to travel to the beach with all your supplies! - WaterSound West features gorgeous walking trails along the lake, through the neighborhood, and to the beach - Chef's kitchen with stunning countertops and stainless-steel appliances - Drip coffee maker in the kitchen, and a Keurig coffee maker in the 2nd floor guest suite - Wet bar with ice maker and mini-fridge - Dining table with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 3 - Cable and WIFI available throughout the home - Laundry room with HE washer/ dryer - Open air balcony with lake views and seating available - perfect spot for relaxing! - Wraparound front porch with rocking chairs - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Incredible designer lakefront home in the Southside 30A gated community of WaterSound West. Only a 1 min bike ride to the private WaterSound West beach boardwalk and community pool. Beautiful lake view of Deer Lake as you go to the beach - no other community on 30A has this access! Tastefully decorated to be a vacation oasis, you will love all the private outdoor spaces as well as the comfortable interiors. This 2800+ square foot home is spacious for up to 10 guests, with three suites plus a guest room adjacent to a full bath. This home has had a full redesign with top-of-the-line appliances, marble countertops from Italy, gorgeous hardwoods and so much more! The bedrooms and baths come with high-quality cotton linens and accessories. Your family will love how easy it is to get to the expansive WaterSound West beach access and large community pool, while also staying in a neighborhood near Seagrove and Seaside. (Please note this neighborhood is not attached to the main WaterSound neighborhood and this home does not have access to WaterSound amenities.) ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and soaking tub, private entrance to balcony
2nd Floor King Guest Room 3 | TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor Guest Suite | TV, two double beds and one twin sleeper sofa - sleeps 3 total, ensuite bath with walk-in shower, kitchenette with mini-fridge and Keurig coffee maker
Bonus | 2nd Floor Twin Daybed in Reading Nook, hallway access to shared full bath with combination shower/tub

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
